name: Vincent Lowell
original_name: ヴィンセント・ローウェル
source:
A mechanic sent to Yukon Base alongside Yuuya. Despite his young age, he was chosen as the chief mechanic of the XFJ project. Highly trusted by his unit due to his wide range of knowledge and skill with a wrench. He’s a hedonist and skirt-chaser who gets along well with VG, but he takes his work extremely serious. He’s known Yuuya since their time in the US army together, and they’re both friends and partners.

[From [url=https://muvluv.com/en/total-eclipse]Official website[/url]]
